title: sempervivum tectorum subsp. atlanticum
intro: Sempervivum tectorum subsp. atlanticum, commonly known as Atlantic Houseleek or Hens and Chicks, is a subspecies of succulent plant that belongs to the Crassulaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including the treatment of various health issues such as digestive problems, skin irritations, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Sempervivum tectorum subsp. atlanticum include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and anthraquinones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
